source: The source text IS Section 7, 'Path Factors' (P. A. Payutto, Buddhadhamma, Ch. 16-18, free online edition buddhadhamma.github.io, retrieved 2026-10-25). 0.5.0 binds the instrument's eight gates to that section's eight path factors, in the text's own order, each quoted verbatim with its locator. The raw pages and the extracted text stay local in void-anchor/sleeper/corpus/buddhadhamma/; the public artifact carries a sampled projection, one cited line per district, and eight cited factor lines.

contract.identity: three content hashes, all in the selftest: painting tag f0f09635 = hash32(id+sha256(painting bytes)); source fingerprint bbbe96ac = hash32('buddhadhamma@1|'+sha256(selected text)); city digest 18ac9948 = sha256({matter, cells, districts}) — identical to 0.4.0, because the gate layer is appended and placed, never written into the matter
contract.factors: gate i asks path factor i, in the doctrine's own order (MN 117, quoted at path-factors-wisdom.txt:29 / Ch. 16 ¶15): right view, right thought, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration. Each factor's own paragraph is quoted verbatim at build time and the build refuses an address that does not carry the factor's name. The table is an appended key in source-dhamma.json (+3,296 bytes); every byte above it is unchanged
contract.acts: six of eight factors are enacted, not asked: right view = hold until the district's shape resolves; right thought = let go of the three wrong thoughts the text names (sensuality, ill-will, cruelty), one hold each; right speech = say none of the four (false, divisive, harsh, idle), keep off the ring; right effort = four steps for the four endeavours; right mindfulness = go back onto ground you have walked (sati = recollection); right concentration = stay still on one point. The two word gates are right action and right livelihood, whose accounts at these addresses are definitions with no gesture in them (three bodily abstentions a walking instrument cannot depict; one definitional sentence about livelihood)
contract.gate_voice: every gate says three things in three lines of the foot strip: WHO it is (factor, Pali, locator), WHAT the text says (its own sentence, clipped), WHAT it asks (act + the text's own list). Each line is ellipsized to one line on a phone so the instruction can never be crowded out
contract.breath: breath = the city's sentences + its paragraphs (50 + 28 = 78), a function of the shipped counts. One step costs 1; a failed gate (second wrong door, or a word said at the ring) costs 3; at 0 the walk ends where it stands with a line that says so. Nothing refills inside a walk (two assignments in the instrument: boot and a new walk). Drawn as a hairline on the frame's inner top edge that shortens as you walk
contract.placement: the eight factors are a path, so the gates are one road: the walk's way out of the city that crosses the most paragraphs, found in the walk's own distance field, divided into eight equal stretches. On the shipped painting: 58 steps, 14 paragraphs crossed, gates at steps 7/15/22/29/36/44/51/58. Deterministic; a different painting moves them; the matter is never touched
contract.recomposition: route -> hash32(tag|U/D/L/R witness) -> visited-tile tone inside a measured band + a hairline trace of the walked path
contract.rest: empty route recomposes to the original pixels (mad64 = 0, changedPx = 0)
contract.witness: compressed U/D/L/R string; blocked steps and gate refusals never enter it; returning to the origin coordinate completes the run
contract.weather: a district's weather is a pure fold: the weather carried out of the previous district turns one notch of the wheel window -> rain -> lamp -> beacon, and the district becomes the first weather its own text carries going round; a district whose text carries no weather lets the carry pass. No assignment, no clock, no randomness
contract.matter: paragraph = district, sentence = building, word = room, character = material, punctuation = a district's weather body; 28 districts / 50 buildings / 1,217 drawn rooms of 1,257
contract.eye: the first-person view of the SAME field (0.4.0, unchanged): closed-form ground-plane projection, camera on the walker's cell looking north, hold raises the eye line, horizon fixed at 0.32 of the view
contract.reading_head: a hairline ring on the walker's cell whose arc is the walker's ordinal in the district's own text order, revealed on the same hold that decodes a room
contract.note: the field note is carried verbatim (six strings, asserted byte for byte), reached by the top-left crop-mark or #note, put away by a tap. No element, no panel, no route
contract.boundary: walls are the painting's own strong edges, drawn by their faces; a refused step marks the shared edge and names the sides still open
contract.ride: 0.6.0 adds the wave: holding a cell past the decode sets that district's cited line riding at its own measured pace (beat = 320 ms/word scaled by chars/word, clamped 260–420; one arch per clause mark; the release window opens at the final clause but never earlier than three words before the end, and closes 900 ms after). Release in the window = sharp; early = soft (rewind to the clause); late = blown; three early releases lose the ride. A ride spends no breath. The score is a pure function of the line (same line + same pace → same plan and digest); the ledger records completed rides per district and nothing else. 0.6.1 makes the score visible before it is played: at ENTERED the sentence carries a rail (a hairline with one tick per clause and a brighter final stretch), the strip teaches 'hold · let go at the end' until the first completed ride, and the release leaves a mark on the rail (solid = held, open = early, double = late). 0.6.4 puts the rail under the sentence's characters: a clause tick sits under the character that makes it, the window band starts at the first character of the final clause, and the playhead is a character position. An early release is no longer silent: for 700 ms the strip says 'early · again from the clause' and the playhead walks back to that clause before the ride resumes, and 'keep holding' is the standing instruction on every ride, not only the first. Same wave, same ledger; no new element. 0.6.5 makes the first run playable without a manual: at FAR the strip says 'tap the painting · it resolves into a city', at NEAR 'tap again · enter the city', at ENTERED 'swipe to walk · hold a room · let go at the end', and those lines stay until the first completed ride. Three early releases now name the loop: the strip says 'the loop is stronger than the line · tap the source line', the source line becomes 'THE LOOP', and it opens the Bell reading at the same address instead of the factor passage; a sharp ride clears it. The artifact also carries its repository URL. 0.6.6 makes the ride an RSVP ring: one word at the focal point, sized to the ring; the ring itself carries the clause ticks, the progress arc, the playhead, and the bright release window, with the painting faintly behind a translucent veil. The hold is 800 ms (340 ms to decode), a 16 px thumb drift no longer cancels it, a browser-cancelled touch ends the ride instead of leaving it running, and a lost pointer capture cannot double-count a release. Three early releases open the Bell POV world in this page — the same Bell, mounted on demand — instead of an iframe about it. 0.6.7 brightens the release window to 0.82 alpha and 4.5 px so the arc reads at phone size, not only the dot. 0.6.8 skins the Bell POV, when opened from the ladder, as the Hermes Mansion: the same causal model and source, in the ladder's quiet palette (near-black ground, hairline controls, no amber chrome), with the title and cover copy naming the mansion. The Threadwalk host keeps its own skin; only the ladder's aperture is quieted.

changes: THE EIGHT GATES BECOME THE EIGHT PATH FACTORS: gate i asks factor i in the text's own order (verified in the corpus, not assumed), quoted from the paragraph where the text gives that factor's own account, with its locator. The resonance that was sitting unused — the instrument's eight gates and the section's eight factors — is now the mechanism

SIX ENACTED, TWO QUIZZED (was one enacted, seven generic cloze): right view (hold/see), right thought (let go of the three wrong thoughts), right speech (say none of the four), right effort (four steps), right mindfulness (go back onto walked ground), right concentration (stay still) are acts you perform; right action and right livelihood ask one word of their own sentence because their accounts at these addresses are definitions with no gesture in them

THE WALK COSTS BREATH: 78 = the city's 50 sentences + its 28 paragraphs; a step costs 1, a failed gate 3, and at 0 the walk ends where it stands with a legible line. Drawn as a hairline on the frame's inner top edge. Nothing is recoverable inside a walk

THE GATE SPEAKS: the silent refusal of 0.3.0 gives way to three lines — the factor in the doctrine's own words with its locator, the text's own sentence, and what the gate asks with the text's own list. The operator asked for the instrument to explain itself

REDUCED: placeGates + its quantile targets, gateCard + the seven generic cloze gates, SIGHT_GATES and the seven-word-gates branch are gone. No route, no element, no control added; the page still has four elements

THE RAIL SITS UNDER THE SENTENCE: 0.6.4 moves clause ticks and the release window from word fractions to character positions, so a tick lands under the comma that makes it, not at 1/n of the words; the playhead is a character position too. An early release now says so for the 700 ms the line takes to walk back to its clause, and 'keep holding' stays on the strip for every ride. The cache-bust block in index.html had been left with live merge-conflict markers from the 0.6.3 pin; 0.6.4 resolves it and pins both modules at ?v=0.6.4

THE FIRST RUN SAYS WHAT TO DO: 0.6.5 puts a play line in the existing foot strip at each distance — tap the painting, tap again to enter, then swipe to walk / hold a room / let go at the end — and keeps it until the first completed ride. It also makes failure a door: three early releases set the loop, and the source line opens the Bell reading at that address; a sharp ride clears the loop. No new element, no new route; the artifact now names its repository.

THE RIDE BECOMES A RING: 0.6.6 replaces the small sentence strip during a ride with an RSVP ring — one word at the focal point, large enough to read on a phone, with the ring carrying the clause ticks, the progress arc and the bright release window. The painting stays behind a translucent veil; the instruction under the ring changes with the moment, not with a timer. The hold is 800 ms, a 16 px thumb drift no longer cancels it, a lost pointer capture cannot double-count a release, and a browser-cancelled touch releases the ride. The loop door now opens the Bell POV world itself, mounted in this page on demand, rather than an iframe about the Bell.

THE MANSION IS THE ROOM AROUND THE BELL: 0.6.8 skins the Bell POV as the Hermes Mansion when it opens from the ladder — same model, same source, same controls, but the ladder's palette: near-black ground, hairline borders, no amber chrome, and a cover that names the mansion. The Bell's own host keeps its own identity; the ladder's aperture is the quiet one. This is a skin and a name, not a new mechanic.

validation.selftest: PASS: node sleeper/ladder/ladder-selftest.mjs — 155 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped at 0.6.8 (142 at 0.5.0; W12 character tick and W13 character playhead added). 0.5.0 detail: 142 passed (113 baseline: 104 unchanged, 9 re-pointed to the new contract, 29 new arms); also PASS with --rgba on the real painting (2172x724, 142/142). New arms: the doctrine's own order read out of the corpus; all eight quotes verified against the addressed paragraph (8/8) plus a neighbouring-address negative; the lists are the text's own; seven factors / unknown act refused; the city digest identical to 0.4.0 and unchanged when the factors block is dropped; budget 50+28=78, monotone spend, no refill, the farthest gate inside the breath; one road with each leg costing its step difference (5+5+5+6+5+5+5+5 = 41 synthetic, 7+8+7+7+7+8+7+7 = 58 real)
validation.browser: PASS: Chromium 390x844 dpr2 and 1280x577. A full walk of the eight factors: gate 1 rise -> lit; gate 2 three holds -> lit; gate 3 four speeches going out while still -> lit (and a real click on the ring failed it: act null, breath -3); gates 4-5 answered from the two doors ('abstain', 'abandoned'); gate 6 four steps -> lit; gate 7 one step back onto walked ground -> lit; gate 8 stillness -> lit; 8/8 with breath 15 of 78 and exit line 'exited · 63 steps · 8/8 gates · 15 ¶ read · breath 15 of 78'. A second walk spent the breath: 78 steps, breath 0, ended 'the breath is spent', line 'out of breath — the breath is spent · 78 steps · 0/8 gates · 0 of 78'. Phone: no overflow (scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth), four elements, the gate card's three lines each end within 2px of their own measured width (no overprint)
validation.determinism: same route twice -> identical sha256; empty witness -> mad64 0, changedPx 0; painting tag f0f09635 and source fingerprint bbbe96ac unchanged; city digest 18ac9948 identical to 0.4.0; gate placement identical twice, moved by a different painting; breath budget identical in every process

interop.factors: sleeper/source-slice@1 factors[] — i, key, en, pali, act, locator, quoteLocator, line, items, district (word gates also answer/cloze)
interop.weather: fold over the district runs of the witness (sleeper.ladder.weather/v0.1, pure)
interop.view: sleeper.ladder.fpv/v0.1 — pure projection (w, h, eye, camera) -> quads; no state, no clock
interop.breath: budget = counts.sentences + counts.districts; step 1, fail 3; pure

limits: The eight gates stand on one road that crosses 14 paragraphs, but they land in only three districts (Ch. 17 ¶6 six times, Ch. 18 ¶3, Ch. 18 ¶16): the city's paragraphs are uneven in size, and even pacing was chosen over even coverage. The city stays open — a walk can leave the road

Two gates are still reading checks: right action and right livelihood ask a word of the text's own sentence because their accounts are definitions, not gestures. That is why there are two and not seven
Breath is one pool with no refill: a walk that wanders may end at 3/8. The eight factors usually take more than one walk; the lamps reset, only the reading ledger persists
NEAR cannot show 96 columns of legible characters on a phone: the composition is carried by tone and glyph texture, and legibility is bought with the loupe
The book is under reserved distribution rights: only the sampled projection, one cited line per district and eight cited factor lines are public; the source URL is printed as text, never as an anchor
The recomposition bakes visited tiles plus the walked trace; it does not re-paint brushwork
The weather wheel's order is the mapping's own declaration order, not a claim about the text's meaning
Determinism is proven on the natural-size pixel buffer; display resampling at other DPRs is outside the contract
THE EYE LOOKS NORTH ONLY: it is the walk's own reading direction
The eye shows ~15 rows legibly and compresses the rest into the horizon line
